meta.name: wechat-ai-app-ops
meta.description: Operate the WeChat Official Account AI-application workflow for articles, weekly digests, rich formatting, draft-box updates, and local handoff. Use for Agents, MCP, Skills, tool calling, workflows, and open-source AI updates; exclude Xiaohongshu and Xianyu.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动管理公众号文章、周报与草稿箱
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果日常需要维护微信公众号内容发布流程
copy.tagline_en: Automate WeChat article management, digests, and drafts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage WeChat Official Account content workflows

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你运营微信公众号：写文章、排版、管理草稿箱、生成预览，并检查发布条件，但不会自动发布。
howto.when: 当你在公众号内容仓库里工作，需要写周报或灵活文章、排版、更新草稿箱或准备发布时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一篇本周的AI工具周报文章。
say.note: Claude 会先检查仓库状态，然后按周报流程起草。

say.text: 用gzh-design给这篇文章排版并生成HTML预览。
say.note: Claude 会调用排版工具，验证HTML直到无错误。

say.text: 检查当前草稿的发布条件是否满足。
say.note: Claude 会读取清单文件，检查各门控条件并报告结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you operate a WeChat Official Account: write articles, format them, manage the draft box, generate previews, and check publish gates, but will never publish automatically.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you are working in a WeChat Official Account content repository, needing to write weekly or flexible articles, format, update drafts, or prepare for publishing.

say_en.text: Write a weekly AI tools roundup article for this week.
say_en.note: Claude will check repo state and draft following the weekly workflow.

say_en.text: Format this article with gzh-design and generate an HTML preview.
say_en.note: Claude will call the formatter and validate HTML until ERROR=0.

say_en.text: Check if the current draft meets publish conditions.
say_en.note: Claude will read the manifest and check all gates, then report.
